hook_text: Every person on Earth has ancestors from Africa, and the clues are in these caves.
clip_script: The Cradle of Humankind, Gauteng. Down steep steps into the Sterkfontein Caves, cool and dark. Here, bones of early human ancestors were preserved in the rock for millions of years. Mrs Ples: a skull more than two million years old. Little Foot: a skeleton that took twenty years to free. Homo naledi: found deep in the Rising Star Cave. The fossils show humankind began in Africa. That makes this place everyone's heritage.
visual_style: Whiteboard cave cross-section with bones settling in layers, then a skull, a skeleton and a long timeline stretching back millions of years.
mood: Awe-filled and wondering, like discovering a family secret.
pacing: Slow descent into the cave, then three discoveries.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find the Cradle of Humankind on a map of Gauteng.
